newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Dec 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Dec 19.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories on Thursday:
- Texaco Inc announced initiatives that would significantly expand virtually all of its business dealings with minorities.
- The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission adopted the most sweeping changes in 30 years in its guidelines on utility mergers.

- Despite arguments from supporters of the North American Free Trade Agreement that the pact would bring big employment gains to the United States and warnings from opponents that it would cost hundreds of thousands of jobs, the accord's net impact so far has been slight.
- Western Resources, which owns 27 percent of ADT, initiated a hostile $3.5 billion cash and stock bid for the rest of the company.
- Entergy agreed to buy London Electricity Plc .
- A Federal jury in Miami awarded $8.75 million to Alan Levan, who had accused ABC News of libelling him on a "20/20" programme about real estate deals.
